Mission Local reported that SFMTA vice chair Gwyneth Borden was censured after she admitted to lobbying city staff and officials on behalf of Fiorella, which paid her $12,500 to help legalize an outdoor deck. She sent dozens of emails seeking support for the restaurant’s permit while serving as a city commissioner. In a follow-up, Mission Local reported that Borden resigned.
